concerns.text: FR-005 (DESeq2 Wald test on discovery set) and FR-006 (Stouffer's meta-analysis) lack a dedicated implementation task. T023 is marked '[ ]' (incomplete) and T024 is marked '[ ]' (incomplete). The plan requires these to be implemented to generate the gene panel for US3, but the tasks are not marked as completed or sufficiently detailed to guarantee execution without further specification.

FR-007 (Elastic-net with nested CV), FR-008 (LOO validation), FR-009 (ROC-AUC/Calibration), FR-010 (Bonferroni), FR-011 (DeLong's test) are not fully covered by completed tasks. T031, T032, T033, T035-T043 are all marked '[ ]' (incomplete). The implementation of the core modeling and validation logic is missing from the task list.

FR-012 (Runtime ≤6h) and SC-004/SC-005 (Resource limits) require T009 (Runtime Monitoring) to be implemented. T009 is marked '[ ]' (incomplete), leaving the success criteria unenforceable in the current task state.

FR-013 (Data Split) is covered by T020, but T020 is marked '[X]' (completed) while T017a/b/d (Preprocessing) are also marked '[X]'. However, T011 (Integration test for Feasibility Gate) is marked '[ ]' (incomplete) despite the gate logic (T014) being marked '[X]'. The test coverage for the critical Data Feasibility Gate is missing.

T025, T026, T027 are listed as 'Remove' tasks but are also flagged in the 'Repeatedly-unverifiable tasks' section. This creates a contradictory state in the task list where tasks are marked as removed but also as missing/rejected, confusing the implementation status.
